tools.name: list_peptides
tools.description: List the peptides Peptides Academy covers, or find the ones matching a name, brand name, code name or topic (for example "Ozempic", "BPC-157", "sleep", "GLP-1"). Returns each peptide id, its names, a one-line summary and its course link. Use it to resolve a peptide id before get_peptide_research.

tools.name: get_peptide_research
tools.description: Get the evidence on one peptide from its Peptides Academy research dossier, with verbatim quotes from the studies and numbered sources. Without a section it returns the summary and the list of sections; pass a section (for example "human record", "regulatory status", "safety", "mechanism") to read t

tools.name: compare_peptides
tools.description: Put the research summaries of two or three peptides side by side, each with numbered sources and its course link, for questions like "BPC-157 vs TB-500" or "semaglutide vs tirzepatide".

tools.name: search_papers
tools.description: Search the research papers and trial registrations behind the Peptides Academy dossiers by topic, peptide, author or journal, for questions like "what studies looked at BPC-157 and tendon healing" or "semaglutide cardiovascular outcomes". Each hit gives the citation, DOI, PubMed or ClinicalTrials.go
